run_SPMDWorker: run a Ray remote SPMD worker that initializes distributed setup and executes a Runner payload
create_SPMDController: create an SPMDController to manage Ray placement groups and launch SPMD workers across Slurm nodes
run_ray_entrypoint: run the Ray entrypoint that instantiates and executes a Runner from a Hydra config
launch_ray_on_slurm: launch a Ray cluster on Slurm with specified scheduler config and run a payload function
review_SPMDWorker_distributed_setup: review the SPMDWorker class and its distributed setup using NCCL or Gloo backends
